card.name: Punctuation before e-number article IDs
card.fires_on: Punctuation or digits in journal citations right before an electronic article number starting with e, such as e865 or e1000275. Common after the volume(issue) in PLoS, Pediatrics and JAMA Network Open references.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis before e-number
modes.description: The colon or parenthesis after volume(issue) where an e-prefixed page ID comes next.

modes.label: Volume or page digits in citations
modes.description: Digits or periods inside a reference's volume and page numbers, where the next item may be an e-number.

card.writes: It promotes tokens starting with the letter e, so it predicts an e-number article ID next.
card.plain: It fires in reference lists when the text is about to give an electronic article number beginning with e.
